question: How do hosts pitch VPNs in this collection?

paragraphs.text: Most hosts frame a VPN as protection on public Wi-Fi, and say it while reading a sponsor script.
A smaller group pitches streaming access abroad and ties it to a discount code.

sources.label: ad · SafeLine VPN
sources.text: This episode is brought to you by SafeLine VPN. Use it on hotel and airport Wi-Fi so nobody can snoop on your traffic.

sources.label: ad · SafeLine VPN
sources.text: Stay private on any network. Go to safeline dot com slash gadget for three extra months free.
